title: Human-generated free and openly licensed language-learning resources by language code

scope.intent: Seed catalog for Langouste resource linking and possible ingestion. Prioritizes human-authored courseware, OER, lexical/reference sources, sentence examples, and human audio with clear free/open terms.
scope.language_key_policy: Keys use ISO 639-1 where available, ISO 639-3 for languages without ISO 639-1, and BCP-47/private-extension-style tags for catalog dialects where the source exposes a dialect rather than a single ISO code.
scope.coverage_policy: The languages object includes every language/dialect code found in the researched source families recorded here. It is not a complete inventory of every ISO 639 language; broad resources such as Tatoeba, Wiktionary, Common Voice, LibriVox, Wikisource, and Wikiversity should be queried for long-tail languages at runtime.
inclusion_rules: Include resources that are human-generated and free to access.
Mark reusable resources only when public-domain or open-license evidence is available at source-family level.
Mark copyright/free-access resources as link_only when copying or training/ingestion rights are not clear.
Do not embed copyrighted lesson text/audio from link_only sources.

fsi.title: Foreign Service Institute language courses
fsi.publisher: U.S. Department of State / Foreign Service Institute; archived by fsi-language-courses.org
fsi.license: Public domain in the United States for original U.S. federal government works; archive states FSI materials are U.S. government public domain.
fsi.ingestion_guidance: Strong ingestion candidate. Keep source attribution and preserve course provenance; verify each hosted file has no third-party insertions before redistribution.

peace_corps.title: Peace Corps language courses
peace_corps.publisher: U.S. Peace Corps; archived by 101Languages / Live Lingua mirrors
peace_corps.license: Public domain in the United States for original U.S. federal government works; page states listed courses are public domain.
peace_corps.ingestion_guidance: Good ingestion candidate for beginner lessons, survival phrases, and audio. Verify files are Peace Corps originals.

dli_gloss.title: DLI GLOSS lessons
dli_gloss.publisher: Defense Language Institute Foreign Language Center
dli_gloss.license: Free public access, but lesson pages are copyright-marked by DLIFLC; do not ingest lesson text/audio without explicit permission.
dli_gloss.ingestion_guidance: Index metadata and link out. Do not store copyrighted lesson content.

coerll.title: COERLL open educational resources
coerll.publisher: Center for Open Educational Resources and Language Learning, University of Texas at Austin
coerll.license: Openly licensed OER; site footer shows Creative Commons Attribution license.
coerll.ingestion_guidance: Good source for modern, classroom-ready OER. Check individual resource pages because embedded third-party media may have separate terms.

boise_oer.title: Boise State World Languages OER
boise_oer.publisher: Boise State University Department of World Languages
boise_oer.license: Open Educational Resources; page defines OER as public-domain or openly licensed materials permitting use, revision, and redistribution.
boise_oer.ingestion_guidance: Promising source for French, Spanish, Korean, and activity materials. Verify license on linked project pages before copying content.

openlearn.title: OpenLearn language courses
openlearn.license: OpenLearn courses are commonly released under Creative Commons BY-NC-SA 4.0; verify individual course page.
openlearn.ingestion_guidance: Usable for noncommercial/adaptation workflows; avoid commercial redistribution unless a page has a more permissive license.

mit_ocw.title: MIT OpenCourseWare Global Languages
mit_ocw.license: Creative Commons license for open sharing; many OCW materials use CC BY-NC-SA, with third-party exclusions noted per asset.
mit_ocw.ingestion_guidance: Useful link/index source; ingest only materials clearly covered by OCW license and exclude third-party assets marked used with permission.

wikibooks.title: Wikibooks language books
wikibooks.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 and GFDL for most text.
wikibooks.ingestion_guidance: Good for open grammar/textbook snippets with attribution and share-alike compliance; quality/completeness varies widely.

wikiversity.title: Wikiversity language learning resources
wikiversity.license: Wikimedia free-content licenses, typically CC BY-SA / GFDL depending on page and media.
wikiversity.ingestion_guidance: Use as supplemental OER with quality review and license attribution.

wiktionary.title: Wiktionary
wiktionary.license: Original text is dual-licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 and GFDL.
wiktionary.ingestion_guidance: Good default lexical reference for any target language; comply with attribution/share-alike and handle multilingual entry parsing carefully.

tatoeba.title: Tatoeba sentence corpus
tatoeba.license: Sentence exports released under CC BY 2.0 FR; CC0 sentence subset also available; audio licenses vary by contributor.
tatoeba.ingestion_guidance: Strong sentence/example source. Store contributor attribution and license metadata per sentence; do not assume audio is reusable.

common_voice.title: Mozilla Common Voice
common_voice.ingestion_guidance: Useful for pronunciation/listening and ASR experiments, not a lesson corpus. Verify locale availability and release version at download time.

librivox.title: LibriVox public-domain audiobooks
librivox.license: LibriVox recordings and catalog metadata are released into the public domain; source texts are public domain in the U.S.
librivox.ingestion_guidance: Good advanced listening input. Pair with public-domain text when possible; older literary language may be hard for beginners.

wikisource.title: Wikisource free texts
wikisource.type: public-domain and freely licensed source texts
wikisource.license: Hosts texts in the public domain or under free licenses such as CC BY-SA; page-level license must be checked.
wikisource.ingestion_guidance: Good graded-reader/raw-reading candidate only after readability filtering and per-work copyright check.

open_textbook_library.title: Open Textbook Library world language textbooks
open_textbook_library.publisher: Open Education Network / University of Minnesota
open_textbook_library.license: Open textbooks are licensed by authors and publishers for free use and adaptation; exact Creative Commons license varies by book.
open_textbook_library.ingestion_guidance: High-quality OER textbook source. Store each book license exactly; some books are noncommercial/share-alike while others are more permissive.

lingua_libre.title: Lingua Libre pronunciation recordings
lingua_libre.type: word and phrase pronunciation audio/video corpus
lingua_libre.license: Collaborative multilingual audiovisual corpus under free license; recordings are hosted through Wikimedia Commons with free-license metadata, commonly CC BY-SA 4.0.
lingua_libre.ingestion_guidance: Good pronunciation source. Pull license and attribution from each Commons file, and distinguish word-level audio from sentence-level speech corpora.
